We have template SMARTS. It seems to be a disconnection of sulfonamide attached to aromatic ring and a side chain with O-CH etc. The forward reaction: Cl-SO2-Ar + C-O-Ar? Actually template shows cleavage of sulfonyl chloride? The retro template (retro_smarts_template) is the reverse of forward: product -> precursors. The retro template: [C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]1...>>Cl-[S...]-[c:4].[C:5]-[#8:6]-[c:7]1... So it breaks sulfonamide bond and generates sulfonyl chloride and phenol? Not sure.

We need to apply to target molecule. Use apply_template to get precursors.
